_instructions.enabled: Only rules with enabled=true can take control.
_instructions.map: Match the XODR basename. Wildcards such as MT_14-*.xodr are supported.
_instructions.station: s_start is inclusive and s_end is exclusive, in metres along the global path.
_instructions.lateral: target_d is the final offset from the complete global path in metres: positive=left, negative=right.
_instructions.lane_change: For a parallel adjacent lane, use its centre-to-centre separation (commonly about +/-3.5m), not a small edge offset such as +/-0.3m.
_instructions.safety: An active rule deliberately bypasses all planning obstacle and collision checks.

scenarios.name: MT_14 example: small right offset (not a lane change)
